title: 12 Sibuyan anti-mining advocates subpoenaed over July protest

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— Twelve community members in Sibuyan Island have received subpoenas from the Office of the Provincial Prosecutor of Romblon over criminal complaints filed by an employee of Altai Philippines Mining Corp. (APMC) over their July 6 protest against the proposed mining project. The Barikada ng Mamamayan ng Sibuyan said on Thursday that the complaints filed by APMC employee Luilyn P. Viñas accuse their members of grave threats, unjust vexation, and light coercion. The respondents were directed to submit their counter-affidavits and supporting evidence as part of the preliminary investigation, according to the group.
